newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzanian shilling slightly down on dollar.
newsitem.headline: Tanzanian shilling slightly down on dollar.

text.p: The Tanzanian shilling fell slightly against the dollar and more sharply against sterling on Wednesday, central bank officials said.
The mean commercial rate for the dollar was 607.8600 shillings, against 607.0779 on Tuesday. Against sterling it was 994.3693, compared with 984.1058.
The British pound soared against the dollar on Tuesday after Britain raised interest rates and set a plan to make the nation's central bank independent.
